recreation_brief: 1. Slide setup: 16:9, white #FFFFFF background. Add NO title, subtitle, slide number, watermark, logo, or date — none exist on the original. 2. Outer frame: no-fill rectangle with ≈2.5pt #00008B border spanning x ≈5.5–94.5%, y ≈7.5–93.5%. 3. Token-box template: rectangle ≈4.2% wide × 4% tall, thin gray outline, split into 4 equal vertical segments colored left→right #FFB6C1, #FFFF99, #C1E1C1, #D8BFD8; overlay the token label at top-center in #00008B ≈9pt with a numeric subscript. 4. Place 4 token rows (32 boxes) at y-centers ≈14% (final output row), ≈33.5% (post-FFN), ≈55% (post-LayerNorm), ≈91.5% (input); in each row put 8 boxes at x-centers ≈20.5%, 27%, 33.5%, 42%, 49.5%, 57%, 77.5%, 84.5%. Between the 6th and 7th boxes place ellipsis dots: 5 dark-blue #00008B dots in each of the three upper rows and 4 green #00CC00 dots in the bottom row (19 dots total). Labels: bottom row X_0, X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, X_5[?], X_N3[?], X_N4[?]; the three upper rows (identical) Y_0, Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5[?], Y_N3[?], Y_N4[?]. 5. Attention bar: solid #00008B rectangle spanning x ≈17–92%, y ≈78–86%, with centered white #FFFFFF bold sans ≈18pt text 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'. 6. Thick arrows: 32 3-D blue #3B3BE0 block up-arrows (8 per set, aligned to the token columns) in 4 sets: input X row → attention bar; attention bar → token row at y ≈69–74%; token row at y ≈53–57% → FFN box; FFN box → token row at y ≈31–37%. 7. FFN box: #D6E4F7-filled rectangle with ≈1.5pt #0000CC border, x ≈16–93%, y ≈37–49%; blue #0000CC bold ≈14pt title centered near the top: 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]'. Along its lower half place 8 mini FFN icons aligned to the token columns: each a small thin #B03030-bordered box containing 4–5 magenta #CC00CC up-arrows feeding a horizontal row of 4–5 green #00A651 dots, with a tiny red 'RELU' tag at its top-right. 8. LayerNorm units (build twice): light-green #EAF6EA dashed rounded rectangle (≈1.5pt dashed #00A651 border) spanning x ≈15–93% — top unit y ≈18–31%, bottom unit y ≈56–69%. Inside each: gray bar (gradient #E8E8E8→#C0C0C0, reads as #C9C9C9) spanning x ≈17–90% (top unit y ≈19–24%, bottom unit y ≈57–62%) with centered ≈16pt rich text 'Layer' (red #CC0000 bold italic serif) + 'Normalization' (black #000000 bold sans); below the bar a row of 8 dark-red #8B0000 filled circles (≈1.6% wide), each with a white bold '+' (top unit y ≈28%, bottom unit y ≈66%), one per token column. 9. Thin arrows (32 total, 8 per set): green #00A651 up-arrows in 3 sets — token row at y ≈69–74% up through the bottom ⊕ circles into the bottom bar; bottom bar up into the token row at y ≈53–57%; token row at y ≈31–37% up through the top ⊕ circles into the top bar; red #CC0000 up-arrows in 1 set — top bar up into the final token row at y ≈11–17%. 10. Residual connections: 4 orange #E8A33D curved connectors (≈2pt), one per side per set: 2 rising from the input X row (y ≈89–94%) along the left and right frame edges into the bottom ⊕ row (y ≈66%), and 2 rising from the post-LayerNorm row (y ≈53–57%) along the left and right edges into the top ⊕ row (y ≈28%). 11. Left annotation column (x ≈7–17%): four two-line bold italic ≈11pt labels, top→bottom: 'Residual' / 'Connections' in orange #E8A33D at y ≈38–44%; 'Output of Self' / 'Attention' in blue #0000CC at y ≈70–75%; 'Residual' / 'Connections' in orange #E8A33D at y ≈79–84%; 'Input  to Self' / 'Attention' in red #CC0000 at y ≈87–92%. 12. Final Output callout: #FFCCCC-filled rectangle with ≈1.5pt #CC0000 border, x ≈7–17%, y ≈10–19%, with centered red #CC0000 bold italic ≈14pt two-line text 'Final' / 'Output'. 13. Bottom caption: 'Word Embedding  +  Positional Information' (keep the double spaces; source may show underscore joins [?]) in bold ≈11pt #800000, centered around x ≈28–58% at y ≈93% at the frame's bottom edge. 14. Optional letterbox: to mimic the video frame, add a solid black #000000 bar across the full width at y ≈93.5–100% so it clips the bottom caption; this is a video artifact, not slide content.
